heading: Thank you for your support
intro: We appreciate the strong community support we have received so far and have met our original fundraising goals. AIHA will need ongoing strong community support. Going forward, AIHA is applying for multiple grants and hopes to receive support from both donor and grant funding. Every dollar helps! No donation is too small.
impactItems: Give securely via Zeffy (100% fee-free) OR mail donations to: Anderson Island Health Advocates at PO Box 88073, Steilacoom, WA 98388
